color.note: Monochrome first. Black and white carry the layout, photography carries the emotion, and Mindify AI green survives only as a signal: live, focused, AI-made, selected. Dark is the primary theme; Light mirrors it for documents and print.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Pure black in Dark — the ground every hero image bleeds into.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternating full-width sections, product sidebars, table headers.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, inputs and product cards — always with a `line` edge.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogs and the open mobile menu — with a `line` edge and `shadow-lg`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: code, logs, the audit trail body.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Darkens photography under text (Hero, image sections). Text on a scrim is always `on-media`. Same in both themes — imagery is always dark.

tokens.name: on-media
tokens.usage: Text, outline buttons and the logo over photography and `scrim`, in both themes.

tokens.name: line-subtle
tokens.usage: Row rules inside tables and lists. Decorative only — never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: section rules, panel edges, the stat row dividers.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders and disabled outline buttons — at least 3:1 on every surface token.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and outline-button strokes on every surface token.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, stat labels, column heads — on every surface token. Nothing lighter for text.

tokens.name: invert
tokens.usage: The solid button fill and the hover fill of outline buttons — the opposite of the page.

tokens.name: on-invert
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `invert` fill.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Mindify AI green as text and lines, never a fill: live dots, focus rings, active nav underline, AI labels, links in product UI. On every surface token and on `signal-soft`. At most one signal per view outside product UI.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind `signal` text: AI badges, selected table rows.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The original Mindify AI green at full value. App icon and favicon tiles only (with the black mark) — never buttons or text.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: The mark on a `brand` tile.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring colour — an alias of signal; at least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success. As text on every surface token and on success-soft. Always with a dot and a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind success text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution. As text on every surface token and on warning-soft. Always with a dot and a word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind warning text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, blocked actions, destructive buttons. As text on every surface token and on danger-soft. Always with a dot and a word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind danger text.

tokens.name: marking-open
tokens.usage: Data marking OPEN — public or synthetic data. Marking bar fill with `on-marking` text.

tokens.name: marking-internal
tokens.usage: Data marking INTERNAL — the customer's internal data. Marking bar fill with `on-marking` text.

tokens.name: marking-confidential
tokens.usage: Data marking CONFIDENTIAL — regulated or commercially sensitive data. Marking bar fill with `on-marking` text.

tokens.name: marking-restricted
tokens.usage: Data marking RESTRICTED — named-access data that never leaves its enclave. Marking bar fill with `on-marking` text.

tokens.name: on-marking
tokens.usage: Text on every marking fill, both themes.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1, the primary metric — ink.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Chart series 2 — signal green, for the Mindify AI result in a comparison.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Chart series 3 — blue.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Chart series 4, baselines and prior art — grey.

families.sans: Barlow, "Noto Sans TC", "PingFang TC", system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Set in capitals (text-transform: uppercase) with open tracking. Short, declarative, one per screen.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline, one per page, over photography or `surface`.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Product and research programme names, feature headlines.

styles.name: display-sm
styles.usage: Sub-sections, panel titles on marketing pages.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Sentence case. Reading text is roomy; product UI runs at body-sm.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: We study how models reason and act, and build AI that extends what people can think and do.
styles.usage: The one-sentence subhead under a display headline.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every agent action is approved, attributed and logged inside your network.
styles.usage: Reading text on marketing pages, papers and dialogs.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Default product UI text: tables, panels, helper text, captions.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Panel and card headings in product UI.

groups.name: Labels
groups.note: The capitals voice: wide-tracked uppercase for navigation, buttons and kickers.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: The eyebrow above a display headline, stat labels. Uppercase, `ink-muted`.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: The big numbers in a StatRow. Tabular figures.

styles.name: metric-sm
styles.usage: Numbers in product dashboards and panels. Tabular figures.

groups.name: Technical
groups.note: Geist Mono is the instrument voice: markings, identifiers, logs, telemetry.

styles.name: spec
styles.usage: Telemetry captions, table column heads, version tags. Capitals in the copy.

styles.name: marking
styles.usage: Data marking bars only. Capitals in the copy.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Identifiers, hashes, timestamps in tables and the audit trail.

spacing.note: 4px base. Product screens live on space-1 to space-6; marketing pages breathe on space-8 to space-11.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside compact controls, between badges.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related fields, button icon gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gaps in a panel grid.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Grid gutters; kicker-to-headline and headline-to-lead gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Headline block to its buttons; page inset on mobile.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page inset on desktop; between blocks in a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding in product pages.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding on marketing pages.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Hero content inset from the bottom.

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: Between chapters of a long page.

radius.note: Square. Edges are cut, not rounded — corners only where a control needs to read as small.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Buttons, panels, images, the hero — the default.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, marking bars, inputs, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status and live dots only.

size.note: Fixed heights keep pages and dense screens aligned.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Toolbar and table buttons in product UI.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Hero and section calls to action.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Hairlines and input borders.

tokens.name: stroke-bold
tokens.usage: Outline button borders, the active nav underline, focus rings.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Marketing NavBar height, over the hero.

tokens.name: nav-height-app
tokens.usage: Product NavBar height.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Max width of page content; imagery bleeds past it to the viewport edge.

tokens.name: text-max
tokens.usage: Max width of a reading column and of Section text.

tokens.name: headline-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the Hero headline block — wide enough for two-line capitals at display-xl.

tokens.name: marking-height
tokens.usage: The data marking bar.

shadow.note: Flat. Separation is a hairline or a change of surface; only overlays lift.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogs, the open mobile menu.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px page-colour gap, then 2px solid signal green.
